verdict.rationale: MoQ's official docs list a first-party moq-cli that imports and publishes MoQ broadcasts from several formats, so the product does ship an official CLI. Nothing in the evidence describes it as suited to AI-native or agentic use, and its command surface is not documented beyond publishing. missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly CLI design (machine-readable output, scripting/automation guidance), documented CLI command reference beyond publishing, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: [moq-cli](/bin/cli.html) - A CLI that can import and publish MoQ broadcasts from a variety of formats (fMP4, HLS, MPEG-TS, FLV, etc), including via ffmpeg.
The default demo starts a relay, publishes a test video, and opens the web player.
